instruction: In apps/server/src/services/action-registry.ts and action-proposals.ts, fullwidth or small-form lookalike brackets/punctuation in task titles or project names survive approval-card sanitization, and if a pending proposal approval card row is deleted from the transcript, subsequent proposeAction calls reuse the stale proposal instead of superseding it with a new proposal and card. NFKC-normalize card text before stripping punctuation, and supersede a pending proposal if its card row is missing when a card is requested.
